annotations.text:
Lilo, designed from your four — verified this time.

Twenty-six screens pulled and every one checked by app name before use. Seeing them properly changed the design more than the last round did.

Luma's event page is far richer than I had it: an ambient wash taken from the cover, a four-tile action row, then labelled sections — Where with a map and the local temperature, Who's coming as three counts, Blasts from the host, and a locked Manage grid. The trip page and Manage now follow it closely.

Wise has Jars — a named pot with its own balance and its own circular actions. A trip kitty is exactly that, so Money became two screens: the kitty, and the settle-up breakdown with its dashed total.

Family gave the home screen: the section toggle sharing its row with the total, an unadorned list, a lot of black. Grok gave Add and Ask, including the collapsed Thoughts row standing in for the reasoning.

Sample content throughout — names, times, prices and references are invented.
The two Luma screens. The trip page is the guest view; Manage is what the organiser sees behind the lock icon — Luma keeps host controls on the same page, greyed and marked, rather than in settings.

The two Wise screens. A kitty is a jar: one balance, one holder, circular actions. Settle up is the breakdown — every row that built the number, then a dashed rule, then the net. The suggestion to collapse three transfers into one is the kind of thing Wise does and Lilo could.
What each app actually does, and what Lilo takes from it. Dark is the one thing not cited — Family ships both themes, Wise and Grok are light. That one is mine, argued on the photography.
